notes: This starter bootstraps a small SQLite migration registry in code.
The fullstack sample ticket board can switch to persisted SQLite storage.
malda db status and malda db migrate use this contract plus the localMigrationRegistry seam.
malda db seed runs initLocalDataPlatform() and then seedLocalDataPlatform() from the scaffolded module.
malda db rollback only rolls back the latest applied registry entry and expects openLocalDataPlatform() plus rollbackLocalMigration<ID>().
